Chart Your Journey at Secretariat

From a collaborative culture to teammates who will always be by your side, find a career that will grow with you. Deliver your impact at Secretariat.

 

ABOUT THE FIRM

Secretariat is a consulting firm that helps companies, law firms, and organizations solve complex business problems—often when there is a dispute, investigation, major project challenge, or high-stakes decision involved. At Secretariat, you’ll work on some of the most important legal, risk, and regulatory challenges facing businesses around the world.

From your first day, you’ll be part of a fast-growing team of smart, curious, and driven people who enjoy solving complex problems. You’ll learn by working alongside experienced professionals and contributing to projects for leading law firms, global companies, and major institutions.

Our teams collaborate across offices and disciplines, bringing energy, fresh thinking, and commitment to every client challenge. We invest in your growth through hands-on experience, mentorship, professional development, recognition, and a culture that values diverse perspectives.

Start your career where your work matters. Make your impact at Secretariat.

ABOUT OUR ECONOMICS TEAM

Secretariat’s Economics team helps clients understand the numbers behind major business and legal questions. As part of our casework, our team members may analyze the impact of a merger on competition, estimate company losses in a dispute due to patent infringement or stolen trade secrets, determine employee fair compensation, or study the effect of market rules and regulations on businesses. Much of our work supports complex litigation, regulatory investigations, and business disputes, where our economists analyze evidence and help explain economic issues to courts, regulators, and decision-makers.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Launch your career by putting your classroom skills to work on real cases, real data, and real business challenges. As an Intern, you will use your curiosity, analytical mindset, and communication skills to help clients navigate high-stakes decisions while learning directly from experienced experts in economics, intellectual property, finance, and litigation consulting.

Interns play an active role on project teams, working under the supervision of experienced case managers and alongside recent graduates and PhD economists to address complex business challenges.

This opportunity is ideal for students who enjoy asking “why,” digging into data, solving puzzles, researching new industries, and writing reports that turn complex information into a clear story.

The skills you develop as an Intern can support a wide range of career paths in consulting, economics, finance, analytics, and beyond.

If you are excited by economics, finance, math, data, or coding—and want a role where you can grow quickly, contribute early, and see the impact of your work—Secretariat is the place to build that momentum.

What you’ll get to do:

  • Dive into real-world data to uncover what is happening in companies, markets, and industries
  • Support quantitative analysis, including gathering, processing, and analyzing data, and conduct qualitative market and industry research
  • Explore business issues that go beyond the textbook by researching companies, competitors, and industries
  • Turn numbers, research, and analysis into insights that clients and legal teams can act on
  • Create clear visuals and presentations that bring complex ideas to life
  • Build hands-on experience with tools like Excel, R, Stata, or Python

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in economics, finance, mathematics, statistics, data science or a related field
  • Expected graduation date between December 2027 and August 2028
  • Minimum GPA of 3.5
  • Comfortable using Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint and experience with Stata, Python, or R
  • Enjoys solving problems, thinking logically, and using analysis to support recommendations
  • Has experience working with data through coursework, projects, research, internships, or other hands-on activities
  • Brings curiosity, creativity, and a willingness to learn new tools, topics, and ways of thinking

  • Works well independently while also enjoying collaboration with teammates, mentors, and project leaders
  • Communicates clearly in writing and conversation, especially when explaining research, data, or ideas

Interested in joining us? Please submit your resume/CV, a cover letter, a writing sample and all applicable transcripts.

description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with a wide range of flexible payment options designed to give customers more choice, accessibility, and a smarter overall experience. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a curious, driven, and thoughtful Product Intern to join our Payments & Fees team. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

If you want to truly understand how fintech works, there's no better place to start than payments — and no better seat than product. The Payments & Fees team sits at the intersection of technology, data, and business, working with payment processors, payment method providers, and cross-functional partners across the company. As a product intern here, you won't be watching from the sidelines. You'll be in the room (or the channel) where decisions get made, picking up context fast and contributing to a team that moves quickly and takes its craft seriously.

You'll support the product manager across a high-throughput environment: helping keep the backlog organized, digging into data to understand payment flows, and working alongside an efficient and technically sharp engineering team, as well as Design and Data teams. Product management is one of those rare roles where no two days look the same — you're constantly context-switching between technical conversations, business problems, and user needs, and that's exactly what makes it exciting.

What You'll Do:

Ticket Management & Product Support

  • Assist the product manager in drafting, organizing, and tracking tickets for changes and improvements to the payments service. Help ensure work is well-documented, properly prioritized, and moving through the backlog. Follow up on status and surface blockers when needed.

Context Gathering & Stakeholder Support

  • Help the product manager stay on top of inputs from multiple stakeholders by gathering background context, summarizing key information, and preparing materials ahead of provider meetings. Respond to routine internal questions by pulling the right information from available resources.

Payment Workflow Analysis

  • Learn and apply SQL to query payment data and support the creation and maintenance of dashboards that track payment performance, processing failures, and operational health. Help flag anomalies in payment flows and assist in assembling data for reviews and investigations.

Documentation & Process Tracking

  • Maintain clear internal documentation for payment flows, fee structures, and operational processes. Help keep cross-functional teams aligned with concise, well-structured written updates.

Agile Meetings

  • Participate in agile meetings and collaborate with engineering, operations, compliance, and support teams. One of the most valuable things a product manager does is serve as a bridge between tech and the business — translating technical challenges into clear language and business needs into actionable requirements. You'll get hands-on experience doing exactly that.

What We Look For:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, or a related field

description:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Product Data Analyst Intern to join our fast-growing team. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience and develop your analytical skills in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Working closely with product team leaders, you'll help define key metrics and performance objectives. You will be fundamental in supporting data initiatives across various departments. Your responsibilities will include writing SQL queries, contributing Python code, and generating charts and dashboards that help teams make data-driven decisions.

Interview Process:

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • Coding assessment (~1.5 hours)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Verbal case study interview. Share how you approach new problems. A “How would you…” conversation
  • Verbal behavioral interview. Share your problem-solving experience. A “Tell me about a time when you…” conversation

What you’ll Do:

  • Support business teams by helping them understand their data needs and analytics priorities.
  • Assist in creating analyses and reports to provide insights that help with growth strategies.
  • Help stakeholders identify new opportunities by analyzing key data.
  • Assist with creating, monitoring, and reviewing reports and dashboards.
  • Help to visualize and present analytics results to make them easy for others to understand and act on.

What We Look For:

  • Currently pursuing a degree in a quantitative discipline such as statistics, math, data science, or computer science, business, economy.
  • Solid understanding of SQL to extract, work with data and create actionable data sets.
  • Familiarity with Python for data processing and analytics.
  • Eagerness to learn and adapt to new technologies quickly.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in English.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Redash, Tableau, Looker or Power BI
  • Experience working with data, which can include: complex dataset creation, reporting, profiling, and machine learning

The Tech You’ll Work With:

  • Python
  • Redshift, PostgreSQL
  • Data build tool (dbt)
  • AWS, G Suite, Mac

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation: The salary for the Product Data Intern is $800 USD gross monthly.

This design engineering role is ideal for someone who loves to sketch, model in CAD, build, test, and iterate, with the consumer always at the center of every decision. You will be hands-on with mechanical design, developing and refining concepts into robust, manufacturable solutions. Working across the full product lifecycle, you will collaborate closely with industrial design, electrical engineering, marketing, and manufacturing partners to transform insights into elegant, viable, and exciting products. AI at SharkNinja

At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.

description:
As a Software Engineer, Intern, you'll have the opportunity to spend 12 weeks working on one (or more) of the engineering teams at SingleStore. You will be at the forefront of real-time technology that’s revolutionizing how companies run their businesses every day. With a continuous release cycle, our engineers are accustomed to moving quickly in a rapid production environment. To do this successfully, we work collaboratively and creatively across teams to maximize our opportunity for impact. We also believe it’s important to celebrate our wins together, whether it be at a local spot or getting out of the city for some exploring.

As a Software Engineer, Intern, you will be empowered to own your projects end-to-end and be an active contributor throughout the product life cycle. To expedite your growth path, you will partner with engineers who deeply care about your success and will lend their expertise to your professional development. Our engineers are not just technical partners/mentors, but are also business partners who are exposed to all areas of the business, working with teams such as product, marketing, and sales.

Role and Responsibilities

Our Software Engineers work on small, collaborative teams to help drive our company forward. Our interns are responsible for projects that are deployed continuously into production over the course of their internship. Your work will include everything from developing features to testing software and you’ll gain a significant understanding of both the product and the business.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Be enrolled in a B.S. Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related disciplineDeep understanding of C.S. fundamentals. Strong programming skills with JavaScript, Golang or TypeScript. Passionate about building highly reliable software. Firm grasp of algorithms and data structures.

Preferred skill and experience

Understanding of core C.S. fundamentals, in particular operating systems, distributed systems, concurrency, multithreading, and server architectures

SingleStore delivers the cloud-native database with the speed and scale to power the world’s data-intensive applications. With a distributed SQL database that introduces simplicity to your data architecture by unifying transactions and analytics, SingleStore empowers digital leaders to deliver exceptional, real-time data experiences to their customers. SingleStore is venture-backed and headquartered in San Francisco.

Consistent with our commitment to diversity & inclusion, we value individuals with the ability to work on diverse teams and with a diverse range of people.

Sponsorship is available for this position and other select roles

title: Software Engineer Intern- Helios

description:
About SingleStore

SingleStore is a cloud-native distributed SQL database built for real-time applications, analytics, and AI. Our platform unifies transactions and analytics so organizations can work with data quickly, reliably, and at scale.

About the Engine Team

The Database Engine team builds the core technology behind SingleStore, including query processing, optimization, storage, data ingestion, distributed systems, reliability, and performance.

As an intern, you will join a small, collaborative engineering team and contribute to meaningful projects that move from design to production through our regular release cycles. You will learn from experienced engineers while developing a strong foundation in systems and database engineering.

About the Role

As a Software Engineer Intern, you will design, implement, test, and improve production-quality software for the SingleStore database. You will work on well-scoped projects, participate in technical discussions and code reviews, and gain hands-on experience solving challenging problems in large-scale software systems.

Your work may include:

  • Developing new features and improvements across the SingleStore database

  • Working on SQL query processing and query optimization

  • Improving storage engines, indexing, and data management

  • Building reliable distributed-system components

  • Working with concurrency, multithreading, and fault tolerance

  • Investigating performance, scalability, and correctness issues

  • Writing production code, tests, documentation, and technical designs

  • Collaborating with engineers, product managers, and cross-functional partners

Depending on the team and project, you may also work with performance engineering, SIMD, LLVM-based code generation, search, vector search, cloud infrastructure, or AI data workloads.

Required Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

  • Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and computer architecture

  • Understanding of concurrency, multithreading, and server-based systems

  • Programming experience in C++ or C

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Ability to communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with teammates

  • Curiosity, ownership, and willingness to learn

Prior professional experience is not required. We welcome candidates who have developed their skills through coursework, research, projects, internships, or open-source contributions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Coursework or project experience in databases, distributed systems, operating systems, compilers, networking, or storage systems

  • Experience debugging or optimizing systems-level software

  • Familiarity with Linux or Unix-based systems

  • Experience with performance profiling, memory management, or low-level programming

  • Experience contributing to production software or substantial technical projects

What You’ll Gain

  • Hands-on experience building software for a production distributed database

  • Mentorship from experienced database and systems engineers

INTERNSHIP OPPORTUNITY

The Data Science Intern(s) will work closely with other members of the Data Science team, Investment Analysts, and Data Engineers to analyze, extend, and build on Viking’s significant repository of alternative data assets and generate actionable investment insights.

We seek an analytical and creative problem solver and provide them with the resources and tools to apply their Data Science training and experience to our most pressing and interesting research questions. RESPONSIBILITIES

Data Science Intern(s) will have the opportunity to develop impactful analyses and insights to be used

across our investment process and organization. Activities could include but are not limited to:

  • Build and deliver predictive analytics on companies, sectors, and macroeconomic trends
  • Translate alternative data analysis into actionable insights for the investment team
  • Develop methodologies to identify and evaluate investment opportunities in private companies

  • Streamline the data life cycle, operating model, and process

At CesiumAstro , we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team. The CesiumAstro software team is looking for Summer 2027 interns to design embedded software for satellite communication systems. Embedded software development interns will work closely with CesiumAstro engineers on low-level and high-level software in CesiumAstro’s space electronics products. Areas of focus will include microcontroller programming, low-level drivers, board support packages (BSP), end-use applications, and user interfaces. Assignments will be determined by a mix of project availability and the interests of the successful candidates. Cesium interns regularly present their work to peers, mentors, and CesiumAstro executive leadership throughout the course of the summer. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required. To apply, please include a cover letter describing your interest in embedded software development and either space systems or communication systems.

description: Team Description: Kitware’s Computer Vision team is a leader in the creation of cutting-edge algorithms and software for automated image and video analysis. We understand the difficulties in extracting, interpreting, and utilizing information across images, video, metadata, and text, and we recognize the need for robust, affordable solutions. We seek to advance the fields of computer vision and deep learning through research and development and through collaborative projects that build on our open source software platforms, such as Kitware Image and Video Exploitation and Retrieval (KWIVER) toolkit. About the Projects: We consider the work that we do on our government contracts one of the ways that we give back to the community. We relish the opportunity to work on hard problems that have a direct impact on the health, safety and security of our community; our team members choose Kitware instead of working in large internet companies to sell web advertisements. One of our core values is to make the technology we develop as broadly available as possible.

About the Projects: Kitware’s employees have unique opportunities to interact and collaborate directly with customers, visit interesting customer sites, and participate in live field tests and demonstrations. Much of Kitware’s work involves applying state-of-the-art artificial intelligence and mechanistic modeling approaches to dynamic, real-world problems. Kitware employs an open source business model to foster extended, collaborative communities and to provide effective, flexible, and high-quality technical solutions.

description: At Toyota Research Institute (TRI), we’re on a mission to improve the quality of human life. We’re developing new tools and capabilities to amplify the human experience. To lead this transformative shift in mobility, we’ve built a world-class team advancing the state of the art in AI, robotics, driving, and material sciences. This is a paid 12-week internship opportunity and is a hybrid, in-office role. Here’s a glimpse into the Internship experience from some of our TRI interns! At Toyota Research Institute (TRI), we’re on a mission to improve the quality of human life. We’re developing new tools and capabilities to amplify the human experience. To lead this transformative shift in mobility, we’ve built a world-class team in Human-Centered AI, Large Behavior Models, Robotics, Automated Driving, Energy & Materials and Human Interactive Driving. The Team This internship opportunity falls within the Adaptive Behavior Systems team of Human-Centered AI Division (HCAI). We are an integrated team of ML researchers and social and behavior scientists. At the core of our work, we aim to enable decisions through human-centered AI that advance collective well-being for people and the planet. The Internship We are seeking a highly motivated and talented PhD research intern to join our adaptive behavior systems team to push the boundaries of causal reasoning in LLMs. The intern will collaborate with our interdisciplinary team of machine learning, behavioral, and social scientists to study how well language-based generative machine learning models can reason causally and to develop methods for testing and improving causal reasoning. The project will be focused on researching in a specific sub-area of the overall goal, towards publication in a top-tier venue. The intern will further engage in strategy discussions about how the research connects to business impact at Toyota. This is a Winter 2027 paid 12-week internship opportunity. Please note that this internship will be a hybrid in-office role.
